sections.heading: PI gain starting points
sections.text: Same as LLC: kp ~ fr/Vout (Hz/V), ki ~ fr/(5*Vout) (Hz/(V*s)). SRC gain curve is steeper than LLC at light load, so gains may need to be higher. At heavy load, gains should be lower.

sections.heading: Gain direction
sections.text: Increasing kp speeds up response but can cause frequency overshoot. If the frequency command oscillates, reduce kp. SRC has narrower control range than LLC — verify the frequency range covers the required input voltage range.

sections.heading: Sample time
sections.text: Same as LLC: sample time <= 1/(10*fsw_max). For a 200 kHz SRC, sample at <= 5 us.
